params.comment: The Engagement tab's collector is quality/collectors/engagement/engagement.mjs. origin is the live site it reads; sitemap and max_pages bound the pages a names read fetches. Each entry's params.measure says what to read: the read kinds are listed at the top of the collector. Goals come from the engagement plan's metrics table (approved 2026-11-15); its now column was read 2026-11-15.

source: state: the live home page, elements carrying data-starts (an event) or data-day (a weekly thread), outside any hidden element or template
